SELECT id, stall_id, name, description, price, image_url, is_available, stock FROM menu_items WHERE stall_id = #{stallId} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menu_items (stall_id, name, description, price, image_url, is_available, stock) VALUES (#{stallId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{imageUrl}, IFNULL(#{isAvailable}, TRUE), IFNULL(#{stock}, 0))
mapper.update: UPDATE menu_items SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, stock = #{stock} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE menu_items SET stock = stock + #{qty}, is_available = CASE WHEN (stock + #{qty}) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE is_available END WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE menu_items SET stock = stock - #{qty}, is_available = CASE WHEN (stock - #{qty}) <= 0 THEN FALSE ELSE is_available END WHERE id = #{id} AND stock >= #{qty}
